Tomato___Early blight.immediate: Remove infected lower leaves immediately and destroy them. Do not compost.
Tomato___Early blight.organic: Apply Neem oil or Copper-based fungicide every 7-10 days.
Tomato___Early blight.chemical: Use Chlorothalonil or Mancozeb based fungicides.
Tomato___Early blight.prevention: Rotate crops, mulch around the base to prevent soil splash, and water at the base (not leaves).

Tomato___Late blight.immediate: Destroy infected plants immediately to prevent spread to nearby fields.
Tomato___Late blight.organic: Copper sprays can slow down the spread.
Tomato___Late blight.prevention: Avoid overhead watering. Ensure good air circulation.

Tomato___Healthy.organic: Maintain regular watering and organic fertilization.
Tomato___Healthy.prevention: Monitor regularly for early signs of pests or spots.

Potato___Late blight.immediate: Cut down and destroy infected foliage.

Cucumber___Downy mildew.prevention: Trellis vines for airflow, avoid overhead watering.
